observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: an outdoor paved public square or plaza with trees, buildings, and a dome in the background, daytime, surrounded by a crowd of onlookers watching and filming
observation.dancers: mixed group of teenagers and young adults, both male and female, dancing individually and in small groups
observation.formation_and_space: informal circle or open space where dancers take turns performing in the center while others watch from the perimeter
observation.posture: upright torso, knees bent and springing with continuous bouncing motion, weight shifting rapidly between feet
observation.footwork: fast repetitive hopping on one foot while kicking, flicking, or pumping the other leg outward and inward in time with the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms swing loosely or pump naturally with the leg movements, sometimes held out for balance or crossed over the chest
observation.hips_and_torso: torso relatively upright with slight forward lean, moving vertically up and down with the jump rhythm
observation.partnering: none, all dancing solo or side-by-side without physical contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent low jumps and high jumps, leg kicks at mid-height, occasional directional turns while hopping
observation.costume_and_props: casual street clothing including hoodies, t-shirts, jeans, cargo pants, and sneakers; no props held
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and subtle weight changes are obscured by low video resolution and fast motion

signature_moments.what: two dancers hopping rapidly on one foot while kicking and flicking the free leg outward synchronously
a dancer executing powerful high jumps and rapid leg pumps in place
a group of four dancers performing simultaneous synchronized jumpstyle kicking steps
a male and female dancer facing the camera performing fast alternating leg kicks and hops
